hero.title: Tell us the job. We survey it, price it, staff it and see it through.

work.title: Four ways to work with us
work.intro: Whether you work alone or bring a hundred people, there is a place for you.
work.notice: Pro Engineering does not charge workers any fee to register.

worker.title: Worker
worker.desc: Register yourself in your own trade. Once approved, we book you on jobs near you.

teamHead.title: Team Head
teamHead.desc: You lead a team. Tell us the skills and numbers you bring, and we book the team on jobs.

associate.title: Associate
associate.desc: You are strong in labour supply. Your workers join Pro Engineering and you earn a commission on their work.

contractor.title: Contractor
contractor.desc: You can take on a whole job. We pass suitable job requests to you and you deliver to the client.

how.title: How a job moves, step by step
how.intro: The same eight steps apply whether the job takes a day or three months.

steps.title: You post the job
steps.desc: Online, or our team records it for you after a call or visit.

steps.title: We survey the site
steps.desc: When the job needs it, a supervisor visits and measures before anything is priced.

steps.title: We prepare the estimate
steps.desc: Built from the survey, the scope of work and the workers and material needed.

steps.title: The estimate is approved internally
steps.desc: It is checked and signed off by our senior team before you see it.

steps.title: You review it
steps.desc: You see the estimate, ask for changes and agree the final scope and price.

steps.title: Workers are allotted
steps.desc: By trade, skill and location, day by day, from our registered workers.

steps.title: Work is supervised
steps.desc: A supervisor inspects on site and records progress against each milestone.

steps.title: You pay by milestone
steps.desc: Payments follow completed stages, through to handover.

homeZones.title: Service areas
homeZones.intro: You choose your state, district and sector when you raise a request.

video.title: Plan your workforce with us
video.body: Tell us what your site needs over the coming weeks and we will work out the skills and numbers with you, at no charge.

closing.title: Ready to start?
closing.body: Raise a request in a few minutes, or register to work with us.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Work is organised by trade, then by skill, then by the job itself. Complete jobs at one price are listed as lump sum jobs.
services.projectsIntro: For larger projects with a budget and a schedule, start a full project enquiry.

forWorkers.title: Steady work, close to home

reasons.title: Clear records

steps.title: Start working
